aboutText: Automation-driven Senior QA Engineer / SDET with 8+ years building and scaling test automation across web, desktop, API, and hardware platforms. Built and maintained 2,000+ automated tests across multiple roles with Selenium, Playwright, Java, Python, and TypeScript, cutting regression time by 20% through CI/CD quality gates that validate every pull request in Jenkins and Azure DevOps. Owns QA tech-stack architecture and tooling decisions, drives shift-left test strategy, API automation, and AI-assisted test design (Codex) as a strong cross-functional collaborator in Agile/Scrum teams, applying a Quality Engineering mindset and comfortable owning problems independently. Fluent in English, remote-ready, with US time-zone overlap.
